destrieux.label_method: Original FreeSurfer aparc.a2009s+aseg labels, lossless ID encoding

hcp-mmp.label_method: Derived nearest pial/white vertex labels, restricted to published cortical voxels AND native gray ribbon; other tissues unchanged

limitations: Native 1 mm reference-template tissue labels; no claim of subvoxel anatomical accuracy.
HCP cortical volume labels are a derived ribbon-restricted projection, not a published native HCP volumetric atlas.
Native voxel boundaries and high-resolution cortical surfaces may not coincide exactly.
